These PCM WAV files are upstream Alkove test fixtures:
https://github.com/alkove-ai/alkove/tree/main/packages/alkove/test/fixtures
Retrieved 2026-11-06 for local integration verification.
Upstream source/weights: Apache-2.0; notices in models/ALKOVE-NOTICE.txt.
They are test data, not a user's saved voice profile.
Do not ship them as an enrolled default identity. Test fixtures are excluded
from the application bundle. A user must explicitly enroll their own voice.
